subtitle: 21 Luxury Marble, Tactile Fabric & Deep Fluted Finishes with 100% Anti-Seelan Protection
tagline: India's premier designer wall cladding. Featuring India's first tactile fabric finish, Italian marble aesthetics, and architectural fluted louvers for modern homes in Gurgaon & Delhi NCR.
description: Engineered for luxury residences, corporate offices, and moisture-prone homes across Gurgaon and Delhi NCR. The Elite Collection pairs extra-wide 12-inch (300mm) seamless PVC cladding with deep architectural fluted panels. Offering India's first authentic tactile fabric texture alongside Italian marble and rich woodgrains, Elite delivers zero-maintenance elegance with certified 100% waterproof and termite-proof durability.

faqs.question: What is the price of Elite PVC and Fluted wall panels in Gurgaon?
faqs.answer: In Gurgaon and Delhi NCR, Elite 12-inch PVC panels are priced starting at ₹549 per panel (approx. ₹58/sq.ft wholesale), while Elite Fluted panels are priced at ₹599 per panel (approx. ₹65 to ₹95/sq.ft). As a direct wholesale supplier, Goals Floors provides factory-direct rates with bulk project discounts for Gurgaon residential apartments, villas, and commercial spaces.

faqs.question: What makes the Elite Fabric Texture panel (GF-411) unique in India?
faqs.answer: The GF-411 is India's first authentic tactile fabric texture wall panel. Unlike standard wallpaper that stains, rips, or peels due to monsoon humidity, the GF-411 features a micro-embossed linen weave texture backed by a 100% waterproof closed-cell polymer core. It delivers the soft tactile luxury of fabric with wipe-clean polymer durability.

faqs.question: Are Elite wall panels completely waterproof and immune to dampness (seelan)?
faqs.answer: Yes, 100%. Elite wall panels are manufactured from high-density virgin polymer PVC and WPC composite with zero organic wood fillers. They have a certified 0.0% water absorption rate (ASTM-D570), making them immune to swelling, warping, fungus, and peeling paint caused by severe wall dampness (seelan) in Gurgaon basements and ground floors.

faqs.question: What are the exact dimensions and wall coverage of Elite panels?
faqs.answer: Each Elite panel measures 9.5 feet in length by 12 inches in width (2950 mm × 300 mm). A single panel covers approximately 9.52 sq.ft. The 300mm extra-wide format significantly reduces visible joints compared to standard 6-inch panels, creating a modern unbroken architectural surface from floor to ceiling.

faqs.question: Can Elite wall panels be installed over damaged seepage walls or uneven plaster?
faqs.answer: Yes. If the wall has severe paint peeling, crumbling plaster, or dampness, our professional installation team in Gurgaon mounts a lightweight aluminum or moisture-treated plywood sub-grid before fixing the panels. This isolates the decorative panels from damp masonry, ensuring a perfectly plumb, permanent finish.

faqs.question: What is the difference between Elite 12-Inch PVC and Elite Fluted panels?
faqs.answer: Elite 12-Inch PVC panels (GF-401 to GF-412) feature a smooth, seamless monolithic profile with luxury marble, fabric, and stone textures. Elite Fluted panels (FP-714 to FP-722) feature deep vertical architectural ridges (flutes) that create dramatic shadow play and help diffuse ambient acoustic echoes in media rooms and TV unit backdrops.

faqs.question: How do you clean and maintain Elite wall panels?
faqs.answer: Elite panels require virtually zero maintenance. Thanks to the Diamond Scratch Armor UV protective topcoat, dust, oil, and fingerprints do not penetrate the surface. Routine cleaning requires only a quick wipe with a damp microfiber cloth. No repainting, varnishing, or chemical cleaners are ever required.
